newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to cut its contribution to CERN.
newsitem.headline: France to cut its contribution to CERN.

text.p: France is to cut its financial contribution to the European Laboratory for Particle Physics (CERN) from 1997, junior research minister Francois d'Aubert said on Friday.
France's 1997 funding of the Geneva-based research centre will be 7.5 percent below what was initially planned, the minister said in a statement which gave no precise figures.

D'Aubert said France's decision followed a similar one made by Germany last August and was taken only after a recent CERN council adopted a budget which will allow the centre to pursue its scientific activities at lower funding levels.
From 1998 to 2000, France is to pay the CERN 8.5 percent less than what was first agreed. From 2001, France's contribution will have dropped by 9.3 percent from that initially planned.
